## Introduction

This notebook builds a SingleR reference from the age-filtered AML scAtlas subset written by
`02_subset-atlas.py` (`data/AML-scAtlas/AML_scAtlas_le29.h5ad`).

- Labels: `label_fine` (predictions can be collapsed to `label_broad` afterwards; every
  `label_fine` class maps to exactly one `label_broad` class).
- To keep the large studies from dominating, cells are downsampled to at most
  `max_cells_per_group` cells per `label_fine` class per donor.
- Counts are log-normalized with `scuttle::logNormCounts()` on all atlas genes; training is then
  restricted to genes present in every library of the ScPCA AML project (`SCPCP000007`).
- The reference is trained with `trainSingleR(de.method = "wilcox", aggr.ref = TRUE)`.

## Setup

```{r setup}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(SingleR)

set.seed(2026)

# Settings
max_cells_per_group <- 100 # cap per label_fine class per donor
label_col <- "label_fine"
n_workers <- 4

# Paths
root_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_dir(".git"))
module_dir <- fs::path(root_dir, "analyses", "annotate-aml")
atlas_file <- fs::path(root_dir, "data", "AML-scAtlas", "AML_scAtlas_le29.h5ad")
scpca_project <- "SCPCP000007" # ScPCA project made up primarily of AML samples
scpca_dir <- fs::path(root_dir, "data", "scpca", scpca_project)

results_dir <- fs::path(module_dir, "results")
fs::dir_create(results_dir)
ref_sce_file <- fs::path(results_dir, "AML_scAtlas_le29_singler_ref_sce.rds")
trained_ref_file <- fs::path(results_dir, "AML_scAtlas_le29_singler_trained_ref.rds")
```

## Genes shared with ScPCA

The ScPCA AnnData files index genes by Ensembl ID (`var/_index`). Only that dataset is read
from each file, so this is cheap.

```{r scpca-genes}
scpca_files <- fs::dir_ls(scpca_dir, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*_filtered_rna.h5ad")
length(scpca_files)

scpca_gene_lists <- purrr::map(
  scpca_files,
  \(f) as.character(rhdf5::h5read(f, "var/_index"))
)
scpca_genes <- purrr::reduce(scpca_gene_lists, intersect)
length(scpca_genes)
```

## Read the atlas subset and downsample

Open the file on disk, so only the metadata is read at first.

```{r open-atlas}
adata <- anndataR::read_h5ad(atlas_file, as = "HDF5AnnData")
adata

obs <- adata$obs
obs$cell_id <- adata$obs_names
```

How many atlas genes are present in ScPCA?

```{r gene-overlap}
atlas_genes <- adata$var_names
shared_genes <- intersect(atlas_genes, scpca_genes)
c(
  atlas = length(atlas_genes),
  scpca = length(scpca_genes),
  shared = length(shared_genes)
)
stopifnot(length(shared_genes) > 0.9 * length(atlas_genes))
```

Cap each `label_fine` class at `max_cells_per_group` cells per donor.

```{r downsample}
sampled_obs <- obs |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data[[label_col]], donor_id) |>
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = max_cells_per_group) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

nrow(sampled_obs)
```

Cells per label before and after downsampling, with the number of donors contributing to each
label:

```{r downsample-summary}
before <- obs |>
  dplyr::count(.data[[label_col]], name = "n_cells_before")

after <- sampled_obs |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data[[label_col]]) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_cells_after = dplyr::n(),
    n_donors = dplyr::n_distinct(donor_id),
    n_studies = dplyr::n_distinct(Study),
    max_study_fraction = max(table(as.character(Study))) / dplyr::n()
  )

dplyr::left_join(before, after, by = label_col) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_cells_after))
```

## Build the reference SingleCellExperiment

Subset to the sampled cells (keeping file order), then convert. `X` holds raw counts, so it
becomes the `counts` assay.

```{r convert}
keep_cells <- obs$cell_id[obs$cell_id %in% sampled_obs$cell_id]

ref_sce <- adata[keep_cells, ]$as_SingleCellExperiment(
  x_mapping = "counts",
  assays_mapping = FALSE,
  colData_mapping = TRUE,
  rowData_mapping = TRUE,
  reducedDims_mapping = FALSE,
  colPairs_mapping = FALSE,
  rowPairs_mapping = FALSE,
  metadata_mapping = FALSE
)
rm(adata)

# make sure the counts are a sparse matrix in memory
counts(ref_sce) <- as(counts(ref_sce), "CsparseMatrix")
ref_sce
```

Log-normalize using library size factors computed on all atlas genes.

```{r normalize}
ref_sce <- scuttle::logNormCounts(ref_sce)
summary(sizeFactors(ref_sce))
```

## Train SingleR

`restrict` limits marker selection and training to the genes shared with ScPCA.
`aggr.ref = TRUE` aggregates each label into pseudo-bulk profiles, which keeps the trained
reference small and classification fast.

```{r train}
trained_ref <- trainSingleR(
  ref = ref_sce,
  labels = ref_sce[[label_col]],
  de.method = "wilcox",
  aggr.ref = TRUE,
  restrict = shared_genes,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = n_workers)
)
trained_ref
```

Total number of unique marker genes selected across all labels:

```{r markers}
marker_genes <- unique(unlist(trained_ref$markers$full))
length(marker_genes)
```

## Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(ref_sce, ref_sce_file)
saveRDS(trained_ref, trained_ref_file)
```
